where.screen_path: Connections > Membership > Issue a membership > issue-show step (new amber Request co-signs banner when threshold > 1). Modal > Request a co-sign (now constructible from MembershipModal in orgContext mode).

what.action: Single-commit session wiring the Phase C cut 3 caller so the org-issuance loop closes end-to-end. buildMembershipDraft accepts an optional authorizedBy payload that bakes a top-level authorized_by leaf carrying the disclosure proof of the routine_issuance auth rule; the org's signature covers that leaf so it cannot be detached and swapped. MembershipModal derives the operator's own org self-declaration via findOwnOrgDeclaration, looks up the routine_issuance rule via findAuthRule, builds the AuthorizedByPayload, threads it through buildMembershipDraft, and — when the rule's threshold > 1 — surfaces an amber Request co-signs banner on the issue-show step that opens CosignRequestModal in orgContext mode via a lazy import that shares the chunk JournalDetail and PromoteRouter already pulled.
what.summary: Commit d0283b4 closes the Phase C cut 3 end-to-end. createMembership.ts gains the optional authorizedBy parameter on buildMembershipDraft with a back-compat path that omits the leaf when omitted; pre-Phase-8 orgs continue to ship the original five-field membership shape unchanged. MembershipModal.tsx pulls findOwnOrgDeclaration, findAuthRule, and buildAuthorizedByPayload into useMemo derivations off holdings + wallet.identity, threads authorizedBy into the existing wallet.sign call, and renders the new banner conditional on ownOrg && issuanceRule && threshold > 1 && membership. A lazy-loaded CosignRequestModal opens with {orgSelfDecl: ownOrg, action: 'routine_issuance'} when the operator taps the banner button. createMembership.test.ts ships four round-trip tests through verifyOrgAuthorization: back-compat draft without authorized_by, threshold=1 founder-only happy path, threshold=2 single-sig refusal with threshold-not-met reason, threshold=2 dual-sig acceptance once the second eligible signer co-signs the same envelope. PLAN.md Phase C bullet marked [DONE 2026-05-26] with one-paragraph rollup of cuts 1/2/3. connections/manifest.ts notes extended with a final sentence describing the closed loop + the new test file added to touches. All four gates green: typecheck, lint, 140/140 tests (4 new), build clean in ~3.3s with bundle budgets passing — no budget bumps needed.

why.text: Operator prompt 'Cut what is next on list take as big of a chunk as you can handle safely' on a clean SessionStart inheritance from the prior carpenter's letter that explicitly named caller-wiring as the recommended first move. The prior letter flagged the new orgContext prop as dead code until a caller constructs it; this session wires the natural caller (MembershipModal — the org's own issuance flow) and closes the Phase C arc end-to-end so the operator can declare a multi-rule org, issue a membership under a rule, request co-signs from the rule's eligible signers via the constrained picker, and see the rule name on the resulting badge.
